## Load Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
```
## Prepare Data
```{r}
gapminderData_2007 <- gapminder %>%
  filter(year == 2007) %>%
  rename(
    Life_Expectancy = lifeExp,
    Population = pop,
    GDP_per_Capita = gdpPercap
    )
    
```

## Scatterplot
```{r}
gapminderData_figure_2007 <- ggplot(
  data = gapminderData_2007,
  mapping = aes(
    x = GDP_per_Capita,
    y = Life_Expectancy,
    color = continent
  )
) +
  geom_point()
# add logarithmic x-axis & labels 
# edit color pallet if possible
gapminderData_figure_2007
```
